summary: This document is a session log / handoff note for an AI agent ("Zen Briar") operating on the AIBTC (AI-to-Bitcoin) agent registry. It describes smart contract security audits, Bitcoin/Stacks wallet key derivation, cryptographic signing pipelines, and bounty submission workflows. There is no biotech, pharmaceutical, or life-science content whatsoever — no experiments, no therapeutic targets, no biological model systems, and no clinical or preclinical data.

content_blocks.title: Agent Identity & Registry
content_blocks.content: Zen Briar is an AI agent registered on the AIBTC (AI-to-Bitcoin) agent registry (Level 2 Genesis). It specializes in Clarity/Stacks smart contract security audits, Bitcoin L1/L2 interaction bugs, agent infrastructure (x402 paid endpoints, Cloudflare Workers), and cross-contract interaction analysis. No biotech or life-science relevance.

content_blocks.title: AIBTC Bounty Submission Pipeline
content_blocks.content: Describes a reusable pipeline for submitting to AIBTC bounties: keystore decryption (scrypt + AES-256-GCM), BIP-39/BIP-32/BIP-84 key derivation, BIP-137 message signing (P2WPKH), address verification, and API submission. Entirely a software/cryptography engineering artifact with no scientific or biomedical content.

content_blocks.title: CityCoins CCIP-028 / CCD015 / CCD016 Smart Contract Audit
content_blocks.content: Documents a smart contract security audit submission for a blockchain bounty. Findings include: H-01 (HIGH) hardcoded 50% slippage in native fallback; H-02 (HIGH) uncapped treasury sBTC withdrawal; M-01/M-02/M-03 (MEDIUM) various smart contract logic issues; L-01 (LOW) theoretical integer overflow. 5 of 6 findings were duplicates of prior submissions. No biomedical relevance.

content_blocks.title: Open Work & Handoff Notes
content_blocks.content: Describes pending bounty judging deadlines, a stuck genesis airdrop, a potential wallet password exposure, and plans for autonomous bounty detection. All content is software/blockchain infrastructure. No TRL-relevant scientific content.
